description: Floor plans as code. Your AI writes ArchLang; the compiler draws a precise, dimensioned plan and tells it what's wrong.

tool_signatures.description: Explain this hosted ArchLang server in one short page: the authoring loop, the size cap, what is unavailable here, how to get an image URL for a plan, and what the server keeps (nothing). Call it first when unsure.
